narrator: Deep, warm and slow, about 125 words a minute: short sentences, a full beat after each, never rushed. The same voice calls the match, read a touch quicker.

cards.caption: The sky cracked. And the land rose to meet it.
Two banners. One hill. Neither has learned to share.
Far away, a Kaiju egg sleeps. It remembers every meal.
Feed it, and it fights for you. Corrupt it, and it fights everyone.
Hold the hill. Raise the Kaiju.
